items.html: Thus it is found that these thirteen corrections of the beard are the aspect of the kings of Arich Anpin, which rose and were clarified in this hidden Mocha in the manner of female waters (Mayin Nukvin), and were corrected, and from them the thirteen corrections of the beard were made; for even in Arich Anpin there was within it the aspect of the kings, as above. Thus it is found that these hairs of the thirteen corrections of the beard are themselves the aspect of the female waters of the hidden Mocha, and they are those that always rise in it as female waters, because it is female relative to the Keter, as above. Understand this well.
